Local fix pending upstream: clear and seal parse archive sources under their queried archive/<batch>.md name. clear checks for pending completed work like seal and defers with pending-archive. A malformed or unreadable work file blocks clear and seal with pending-unknown.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/a.change: Local fix pending upstream: completed work is checked for exact archivability (check_archivable) and reported as format with a reword/replacement hint; title line compared after stripping; CRLF histories get CRLF marker and separator, and a CRLF separator before a following entry is accepted on retry.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/w.change: Local fix pending upstream: create/update refuse a 完成 save whose body would not archive; a completed work accepts one reviewed replacement keeping title, 更新 and 狀態：完成 when history lacks that identity; update details follow the file newline. A details update that would hide or change the level-1/2 sections after the managed details is refused with details-format; create/update results add warnings for level-1/2 headings inside details and update results add preserved_sections. An archival failure after a completed save returns partial archive-failed with cause_code and recovery retry-archive.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/c.change: Local fix pending upstream: invalid JSON, non-UTF-8 or too deeply nested stdin is an input error, and any unexpected exception becomes a JSON internal error with exit 2. Usage errors use the JSON envelope with code usage and a missing selected file is not-found (exit 2); --help stays plain text.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/s.change: Local fix pending upstream: superscript COM and LPT names are reserved. read_file change detection ignores st_ctime (stat and fstat disagree on Windows with Python 3.12+). A linked --project path or ancestor above the project is resolved once with a strict realpath and registered as the trusted root; check_path stops at that root after confirming it still resolves to itself. The Git root is the resolved path or its nearest ancestor that is the Git top level; a path crossing a link below the repository root is uncertain. Volumes without strict realpath keep the previous full-ancestor link checks. create_file removes the partial file it created when writing fails (same st_dev/st_ino) and re-raises the original error.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/o.change: Local fix pending upstream: duplicate-source detection uses the resolved path when st_ino is unavailable.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/t.change: Local fix pending upstream: tracking: track removes only the exact /.feather/handoffs/ rule and records the '# cc-feather: track /.feather/handoffs/' comment marker in one write; a default save with that marker reports existing-rule and writes nothing.
